To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) Focused ultrasound (FUS) with microbubbles (MBs) can transiently open the blood-brain-barrier (BBB) in a controlled manner; 2) Raman nanoparticles can be delivered to the brain using this approach; and 3) FUS-mediated BBB opening is effective for the delivery of Raman nanoprobes for brain tumor detection.
1. We demonstrated for the first time the feasibility of using FUS and microbubbles to open the BBB and allow delivery of Raman nanoprobes to the brain.
